bearing.config.v1alpha1.RetentionRule.sc.description:
RetentionRule is the tiers of one predicate or one subject kind
 (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Retention and compaction").

kind.description: Every predicate of subjects of one kind.

tiers.description:
From finest to coarsest, each keeping its level of detail for a span of
 valid time counted back from the compaction event's observed_at. The
 last tier has no span.

bearing.config.v1alpha1.RetentionRule.sc.title: Retention Rule

rules.description: The rules. A predicate's rule overrides its subject kind's.

bearing.config.v1alpha1.RetentionTier.sc.description: RetentionTier keeps one level of detail for a span.

detail.description: The level of detail. COMPACTION_DETAIL_FULL, _QUARTER or _YEAR.
detail.title: Compaction Detail

for.description:
How far back it applies, an ISO 8601 duration such as "P18M". Empty on
 the last tier: from there back, forever.

bearing.config.v1alpha1.RetentionTier.sc.title: Retention Tier
